overview: Artisan Row is home to Katta’s craftsmen and guild artisans, producing goods for citizens, merchants, and Senate officials.
history: Founded to centralize skilled labor and ensure regulated craftsmanship.
Guild halls were established to maintain quality and civic standards.
Terraced workshops were added to support specialized trades.
Arcane regulators were introduced to stabilize magical crafting tools.
hooks: A guild artisan reports sabotage in their workshop.
A rare crafting material goes missing from the supply depot.
A Senate order demands urgent production of ceremonial goods.
Arcane crafting tools begin malfunctioning across the district.
